summary: The end of partial institution. The Board institutes SAS's IPR on only some challenged claims and issues a mixed final written decision; the Federal Circuit affirms in part and vacates in part; SAS wins certiorari and the Court holds the Board must decide every challenged claim. Exercises the fwd-mixed and panel-mixed paths and a CAFC cross-appeal.

legs.context: ComplementSoft owns U.S. Patent No. 7,110,936 (16 claims).

steps.event: ComplementSoft sues SAS in the N.D. Ill.
SAS petitions for IPR2013-00226 against all 16 claims
Preliminary response (not in the sources read; route assumed)
Board institutes on claims 1 and 3-10 only, denying review of claims 2 and 11-16
Sur-reply: forced by the pack (see quirks)
ComplementSoft moves to amend (the FWD denies the motion)
Preliminary guidance: forced by the pack (see quirks)
Oral hearing (not in the sources read; route assumed)
Final written decision (Paper 38): claims 1, 3 and 5-10 unpatentable; claim 4 not shown unpatentable; motion to amend denied
Entries of appearance and certificates of interest
Argued before Newman, Chen and Stoll, JJ. (argument date not found; route assumed)
Affirmed in part; the claim 4 ruling vacated (the Board changed its construction without notice) and remanded
SAS petitions for rehearing en banc on partial institution
The full court considers the petition
Rehearing en banc denied, 842 F.3d 1223 (Newman, J., dissenting)
Bill of costs (route assumed; the pack requires it)

gaps.event: Supreme Court reverses and remands (argued 2017-11-27, decided 2018-04-24, 5-4): once it institutes, the Board must decide the patentability of every challenged claim
gaps.why: No pack models Supreme Court merits review; cert-granted is terminal.

deadlines.arithmetic: 37 C.F.R. § 90.3(a): 63 days. Aug 6 + 25 = Aug 31; + 30 = Sep 30 (55); + 8 = Oct 8 (63), a Wednesday.
deadlines.historical: Notice-of-appeal dates not found; the appeals are Nos. 2015-1346 and -1347.

deadlines.trigger_event: denial of rehearing en banc (Sup. Ct. R. 13.3)
deadlines.arithmetic: Sup. Ct. R. 13.1: 90 days. Nov 7 + 23 = Nov 30; + 31 = Dec 31 (54); + 31 = Jan 31 (85); + 5 = Feb 5 (90), a Sunday, so it rolls to Monday Feb 6.

quirks: The PTAB pack's only institution edge is 'Institute trial on all challenged claims', which is the rule SAS itself created. The partial institution that was the whole dispute cannot be expressed, so the walk takes the all-claims edge. Harmless going forward (SAS abolished partial institution) but a pre-2018 history can't be told faithfully.
The PTAB pack forces a patent-owner sur-reply and Board preliminary guidance on the motion to amend; neither existed in 2013-14.
The CAFC pack's panel-to-mixed has no remand branch; the real judgment vacated and remanded the claim 4 ruling.
The CAFC pack tags cert-granted with outcome 'remand'.
